# change-notice

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: A running agent follows a change of its task's mandate without a restart: on tasks.mandateChanged each live agent on those tasks reconnects the equin MCP server (its tools are the new mandate's at once), then is sent every system-prompt section that follows the mandate (Mandate, Supervisor prompt, Task tree…), rendered again — and those that no longer apply named — as an event turn (a side chat opened beside the agent running the task keeps its own mandate and is only told nothing changed for it; on conversation.runHandedOver, a side chat that takes over running its task once that agent closed gets the same refresh) — its system prompt is fixed for the life of its process. The notice is typed now, the way a user message is (a working agent reads it at its next step), and says it is information only, not a request to act; an agent this backend does not run gets none. The delivery is sendSectionNotice, which the owner of any other state a section renders (e.g. the supervisor roles list) calls with its own lead and its own section.
- Server:
  - Contributes:
    - `trigger` "mandate-change-notice.on-change"
    - `trigger` "mandate-change-notice.on-run-handed-over"
  - Uses:
    - `conversations.Runtime`
    - `conversations.submitTurn`
    - `conversations/system-prompt/composer.refreshSections`
    - `infra/events.Trigger`
    - `infra/jobs.defineJob`
    - `tasks/orchestration/mandate.conversationMandate`
    - `tasks/orchestration/mandate.mandateOf`
    - `tasks/orchestration/mandate/definitions.mandateDefinitionEntries`
    - `tasks/tasks-core.conversationRunHandedOver`
    - `tasks/tasks-core.listActiveConversations`
    - `tasks/tasks-core.taskMandateChanged`
  - Exports (types): `SectionNotice`
  - Exports (values): `sendSectionNotice`
  - Register:
    - `defineJob('mandate-change-notice.on-change')`
    - `defineJob('mandate-change-notice.on-run-handed-over')`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by: `tasks/supervisor-roles`
